say:1:1623122001:1.text: You came just in time, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! I need you to look into something.
say:1:1623122001:1.male: You came just in time, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! I need you to look into something.
say:1:1623122001:1.female: You came just in time, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! I need you to look into something.

say:2:1623122002:1.text: There's a puppy down by the docks, ears drooped, pacing in circles. Looks like a sunflower stuck in the shade too long.
say:2:1623122002:1.source_cn: 码头那边有只小狗，一直耷拉着耳朵在那里打转，那样子活像...
say:2:1623122002:1.male: There's a puppy down by the docks, ears drooped, pacing in circles. Looks like a sunflower stuck in the shade too long.
say:2:1623122002:1.female: There's a puppy down by the docks, ears drooped, pacing in circles. Looks like a sunflower stuck in the shade too long.

say:3:1623122003:1.text: And I suspect magic alone won't be enough to soothe it.
say:3:1623122003:1.source_cn: 要让它情绪平稳下来，可能光靠魔法是不行的。
say:3:1623122003:1.male: And I suspect magic alone won't be enough to soothe it.
say:3:1623122003:1.female: And I suspect magic alone won't be enough to soothe it.

say:4:1623122004:1.text: Can you help, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? You're the right person for something this delicate.
say:4:1623122004:1.male: Can you help, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? You're the right person for something this delicate.
say:4:1623122004:1.female: Can you help, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? You're the right person for something this delicate.

say:0:1623123001:0.text: That must be the one... I'll talk to him first.
say:0:1623123001:0.source_cn: 应该就是这只小狗……先用变形术和它聊聊吧。
say:0:1623123001:0.male: That must be the one... I'll talk to him first.
say:0:1623123001:0.female: That must be the one... I'll talk to him first.

say:1:1623124001:1.text: I'm thinking I'll swing by the docks and grab some fried potatoes.
say:1:1623124001:1.source_cn: 我打算去码头整点炸土豆。

say:2:1623124002:1.text: No, you've got me wrong. I mean, what's the point of everything? What do I do...
say:2:1623124002:1.source_cn: 不，你误会了……我的意思是，我们这一生的终极目标，到底...

choice_prompt:4:1623124002.text: No, you've got me wrong. I mean, what's the point of everything? What do I do...
choice_prompt:4:1623124002.source_cn: 不，你误会了……我的意思是，我们这一生的终极目标，到底是为了什么呢？

say:6:1623124004:1.text: Honestly... I don't know. When I was little, I loved aurora flowers. Then, seeing a whole field of them again became the one thing that made life feel worth it.
say:6:1623124004:1.source_cn: 好吧……我并不清楚，儿时的我很喜欢极光花。从那时候开始...
say:6:1623124004:1.male: Honestly... I don't know. When I was little, I loved aurora flowers. Then, seeing a whole field of them again became the one thing that made life feel worth it.
say:6:1623124004:1.female: Honestly... I don't know. When I was little, I loved aurora flowers. Then, seeing a whole field of them again became the one thing that made life feel worth it.

say:7:1623124007:1.text: But as I grew up, I started caring too much about others' opinions... Their stares felt like tiny needles pricking at me all the time.
say:7:1623124007:1.source_cn: 但随着我的成长，我开始在意别人对我的评价，注视我的目光……
say:7:1623124007:1.male: But as I grew up, I started caring too much about others' opinions... Their stares felt like tiny needles pricking at me all the time.
say:7:1623124007:1.female: But as I grew up, I started caring too much about others' opinions... Their stares felt like tiny needles pricking at me all the time.

say:8:1623124008:1.text: And watching everyone scramble just to get by... I buried that wish so deep I couldn't even say it out loud.
say:8:1623124008:1.source_cn: 渐渐看着大家都为了生计而奔波，那个“要找到最漂亮的极光...
say:8:1623124008:1.male: And watching everyone scramble just to get by... I buried that wish so deep I couldn't even say it out loud.
say:8:1623124008:1.female: And watching everyone scramble just to get by... I buried that wish so deep I couldn't even say it out loud.

say:9:1623124009:1.text: Maybe it's childish. I've still been chasing it anyway... but now? Forget a whole field. Even a single aurora flower in full bloom is rare.
say:9:1623124009:1.source_cn: 我不知道自己算不算幼稚，我仍在为此而努力，但……现在别...
say:9:1623124009:1.male: Maybe it's childish. I've still been chasing it anyway... but now? Forget a whole field. Even a single aurora flower in full bloom is rare.
say:9:1623124009:1.female: Maybe it's childish. I've still been chasing it anyway... but now? Forget a whole field. Even a single aurora flower in full bloom is rare.

say:10:1623124010:1.text: I'm at my lowest. Part of me thinks I should let it go. Another part is terrified that I'll have nothing to live toward if I do.
say:10:1623124010:1.source_cn: 此时此刻，我很绝望……我不知道自己该不该放弃这个幼稚的...
say:10:1623124010:1.male: I'm at my lowest. Part of me thinks I should let it go. Another part is terrified that I'll have nothing to live toward if I do.
say:10:1623124010:1.female: I'm at my lowest. Part of me thinks I should let it go. Another part is terrified that I'll have nothing to live toward if I do.

choice_prompt:11:1623124010.text: I'm at my lowest. Part of me thinks I should let it go. Another part is terrified that I'll have nothing to live toward if I do.
choice_prompt:11:1623124010.source_cn: 此时此刻，我很绝望……我不知道自己该不该放弃这个幼稚的想法，但如果我放弃了，我会害怕自己的生活失去了方向。
choice_prompt:11:1623124010.male: I'm at my lowest. Part of me thinks I should let it go. Another part is terrified that I'll have nothing to live toward if I do.
choice_prompt:11:1623124010.female: I'm at my lowest. Part of me thinks I should let it go. Another part is terrified that I'll have nothing to live toward if I do.

say:13:1623124012:1.text: I just... want to see the beautiful aurora flower again.
say:13:1623124012:1.source_cn: 真希望再看一次我心中最漂亮的极光花啊……
say:13:1623124012:1.male: I just... want to see the beautiful aurora flower again.
say:13:1623124012:1.female: I just... want to see the beautiful aurora flower again.

choice:11:0:1.text: That's not childish. I can help.
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 那并不幼稚，也许我可以帮你
choice:11:0:1.male: That's not childish. I can help.
choice:11:0:1.female: That's not childish. I can help.

choice:11:1:2.text: Don't give up. We can find one.
choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 别放弃，满开的极光花还是有的
choice:11:1:2.male: Don't give up. We can find one.
choice:11:1:2.female: Don't give up. We can find one.

say:15:1623124005:1.text: I don't even know if you'd call it a dream...
say:15:1623124005:1.source_cn: 我不知道这算不算梦想……
say:15:1623124005:1.male: I don't even know if you'd call it a dream...
say:15:1623124005:1.female: I don't even know if you'd call it a dream...

say:16:1623124006:1.text: When I was little, I loved aurora flowers. Then, seeing a whole field of them again became the one thing that made life feel worth it.
say:16:1623124006:1.source_cn: 儿时的我很喜欢极光花。从那时候开始，我觉得再看一次漂亮...
say:16:1623124006:1.male: When I was little, I loved aurora flowers. Then, seeing a whole field of them again became the one thing that made life feel worth it.
say:16:1623124006:1.female: When I was little, I loved aurora flowers. Then, seeing a whole field of them again became the one thing that made life feel worth it.

choice:4:1:2.text: Feeling unmotivated? Well, have you ever had a dream?
choice:4:1:2.male: Feeling unmotivated? Well, have you ever had a dream?
choice:4:1:2.female: Feeling unmotivated? Well, have you ever had a dream?

say:0:1623125001:0.text: The magic-rich Lake of Whispers is a good place to start.
say:0:1623125001:0.source_cn: 极光花……轻语湖附近蕴含魔法，也许可以去那里碰碰运气。
say:0:1623125001:0.male: The magic-rich Lake of Whispers is a good place to start.
say:0:1623125001:0.female: The magic-rich Lake of Whispers is a good place to start.

say:0:1623126001:0.text: There it is—fully in bloom. And yeah... it really is beautiful.
say:0:1623126001:0.source_cn: 果然有满开的极光花，的确很漂亮。
say:0:1623126001:0.male: There it is—fully in bloom. And yeah... it really is beautiful.
say:0:1623126001:0.female: There it is—fully in bloom. And yeah... it really is beautiful.

say:0:1623129001:0.text: This should cheer the pup up.
say:0:1623129001:0.source_cn: 看到极光花，那只小狗应该会高兴起来吧。
say:0:1623129001:0.male: This should cheer the pup up.
say:0:1623129001:0.female: This should cheer the pup up.

say:2:1623130001:1.text: So there are still aurora flowers in full bloom... I still have a reason to keep looking. Maybe... my life still means something.
say:2:1623130001:1.source_cn: 仍然还有满开的极光花，也许我还可以继续寻找……也许我的...

choice_prompt:3:1623130001.text: So there are still aurora flowers in full bloom... I still have a reason to keep looking. Maybe... my life still means something.
choice_prompt:3:1623130001.source_cn: 仍然还有满开的极光花，也许我还可以继续寻找……也许我的生活还有意义？

say:4:1623130002:1.text: Woof! You bet I will. I'll find the prettiest aurora flower field there is, no matter how long it takes!
say:4:1623130002:1.source_cn: 汪，我会的！我一定会找到最漂亮的极光花田！也会为此而努力！
say:4:1623130002:1.male: Woof! You bet I will. I'll find the prettiest aurora flower field there is, no matter how long it takes!
say:4:1623130002:1.female: Woof! You bet I will. I'll find the prettiest aurora flower field there is, no matter how long it takes!

say:5:1623130010:1.text: I-I think I don't feel as heavy anymore. Thank you, both of you.
say:5:1623130010:1.source_cn: 我好像……我好像没那么难过了，谢谢你们！

choice:3:0:1.text: Yes. Hold on to your dream.
choice:3:0:1.source_cn: 是的，所以你要坚持自己的梦想
choice:3:0:1.male: Yes. Hold on to your dream.
choice:3:0:1.female: Yes. Hold on to your dream.

say:7:1623130003:1.text: Exactly, Chimms... A beautiful aurora flower can make you happy, but it can't carry your entire life on its petals.
say:7:1623130003:1.source_cn: 没错，奇姆斯……一朵漂亮的极光花会让你开心，但它也许不...

say:8:1623130004:1.text: Or maybe life doesn't come with meaning pre-installed. Instead of struggling to fill that void, just do what makes today feel good. Like me, I came to the docks for fried potatoes. That's it.
say:8:1623130004:1.source_cn: 或者说生活原本就没有意义，与其费尽心思去填满这个缺口，...

say:10:1623130006:1.text: Potatoes or aurora flowers—either way, the only rule is this: it has to make today feel good.
say:10:1623130006:1.source_cn: 我觉得我们可以一起吃炸土豆，也可以一起去寻找极光花，前...

say:11:1623130007:1.text: Woof! Maybe I should get myself some fried potatoes too!
say:11:1623130007:1.source_cn: 汪！也许我也可以整点炸土豆！

say:12:1623130008:1.text: There you go, Chimms. One fully-bloomed aurora flower and fried potatoes. That's a win-win.
say:12:1623130008:1.source_cn: 没错，奇姆斯，你得到了一朵满开的极光花，又能吃到炸土豆。

say:13:1623130009:1.source_cn: 意义什么的，先抛在脑后吧！

choice:3:1:2.text: Stop agonizing and live in the moment.
choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 也许你该从意义的折磨中跳脱出来，活在当下
choice:3:1:2.male: Stop agonizing and live in the moment.
choice:3:1:2.female: Stop agonizing and live in the moment.

say:1:1623131001:1.text: Magic can do a thousand things... but it's not great at filling an empty heart. You managed it anyway.
say:1:1623131001:1.source_cn: 魔法虽然有无数作用，但却很难安抚生灵空虚的内心，但你做到了。
say:1:1623131001:1.male: Magic can do a thousand things... but it's not great at filling an empty heart. You managed it anyway.
say:1:1623131001:1.female: Magic can do a thousand things... but it's not great at filling an empty heart. You managed it anyway.

say:2:1623131002:1.text: Magic is one of the things that drives Esperia forward. Its value is beyond question.
say:2:1623131002:1.source_cn: 魔法是伊索米亚发展的基石之一，它的伟大毋庸置疑。
say:2:1623131002:1.male: Magic is one of the things that drives Esperia forward. Its value is beyond question.
say:2:1623131002:1.female: Magic is one of the things that drives Esperia forward. Its value is beyond question.

say:3:1623131003:1.text: Still, does magic make our hearts fuller, not just our lives easier? Hmm... an interesting topic for another day.
say:3:1623131003:1.source_cn: 但魔法会让我们的精神世界变得更富足吗？唔，或许这是个值...
say:3:1623131003:1.male: Still, does magic make our hearts fuller, not just our lives easier? Hmm... an interesting topic for another day.
say:3:1623131003:1.female: Still, does magic make our hearts fuller, not just our lives easier? Hmm... an interesting topic for another day.

say:4:1623131004:1.text: Anyway, thank you for your help, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:4:1623131004:1.male: Anyway, thank you for your help, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:4:1623131004:1.female: Anyway, thank you for your help, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
